title: vocabularies.describe
description: Ask for one vocabulary's level structure. This object validates the request payload; the response is {slug, levels, revision} or null when there is no such vocabulary — see $defs.Description. The revision is what a remote resolver caches the answer by: without it a CommResolver could only expire a describe on a timer, and a re-imported catalogue would keep validating against the levels it used to have.

vocabulary.description: Slug of the vocabulary to describe.

Description.description: The response. null means no vocabulary carries this slug — the same answer stapel-attributes' config validation turns into INVALID_CONFIG.

levels.description: Levels root first. A level's parent is always a level declared before it, which is what makes the level graph acyclic by construction.

revision.description: The vocabulary's current revision; bumped once per loaded fixture and carried by the vocabulary.changed event.

parent.description: Name of the level this one hangs off, or null for a root level.
